rules: Use 'Space Grotesk' for all page titles and widget headers.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for ALL numbers, prices, PnL, and addresses.
Use 'Inter' for UI labels, buttons, and prose.
PnL numbers must always be colored (Green for positive, Red for negative).
Never center-align data tables; always right-align numbers.

colors.instructions: Override Tailwind config to match these exact hex codes. Map 'primary' to the orange shade. Ensure 'destructive' maps to the red shade.

strategies: Bento Grid for Dashboard: Mix of 1x1, 2x1, and 2x2 widgets.
Holy Grail Layout for Trading: Left Sidebar (Markets), Center (Chart), Right (Order/Positions).
Dense Mode: Reduce default Shadcn padding by 30% for table cells and card bodies.

Badge.style: rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest border-0

Input.style: bg-[#0c0c0e] border-white/10 focus:border-primary/50 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-sm font-mono h-9

Tabs.list_style: bg-transparent border-b border-white/5 rounded-none p-0 h-auto w-full justify-start gap-6
Tabs.trigger_style: rounded-none border-b-2 border-transparent data-[state=active]:border-primary data-[state=active]:bg-transparent data-[state=active]:text-primary px-0 py-3 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors

visual_enhancers.glass_morphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-black/40 border-b border-white/5 (Use for Sticky Header)
visual_enhancers.gradients: No full-card gradients. Use subtle radial-gradient highlights on active states only.
visual_enhancers.shadows: None by default. 'Glow' effects used for status indicators (green dot for online, orange for warning).

elements: Visual Progress Bar: [SL --- Entry --- Current --- TP]
position_card.layout: Compact vertical stack or horizontal strip depending on view.

market_ticker.style: Marquee or static grid. Must show 'Change 24h' in color.

order_book.style: Visual depth bars (background-size percentage) behind the numbers.

icons.usage: Stroke width 1.5px. Use small sizes (14px-16px) for UI controls, larger (20px) for navigation.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-gray-500 is readable on black. Use text-gray-400 if needed.
accessibility.focus: Visible orange ring on keyboard focus.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid dark colors.
Do NOT use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Keep it 'tech' with rounded-sm or rounded-md.
Interactive elements must have a :hover state.
All financial data must be formatted (e.g., $1,234.56).
Positive values = Green, Negative values = Red. Zero = Gray.
